Welcome to Greenacre

Welcome to Greenacre International School.

Greenacre is an inclusive school for children from age 3 through to IGCSE, based in the natural surroundings of Koh Samui.

We support students to be the best version of themselves through academic learning, co-curricular opportunities, cultural understanding and a love for the planet.

About Greenacre Meet Our Team

Learning at Greenacre

A continuous learning journey from Early Years to IGCSE.

Greenacre combines internationally recognised programmes with aspects of the UK curriculum, with clear progression through each stage of school life.

Early Years

A happy, secure and creative environment where children learn through play, investigation and doing.

Environmentality

Environmentality is part of who we are.

Environmental education at Greenacre includes learning in the environment, about the environment and for the environment, developing knowledge, responsibility and more sustainable behaviours.

Our G.R.E.E.N. values shape how we learn, work and grow together.

Growth Respect Environmental Empathy Nurture

Learning pathway

From age 3 to Cambridge IGCSE.

Greenacre offers a continuous learning journey from Early Years at age 3 through to IGCSE at age 16 and is a Cambridge Approved Examinations Centre.
